scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run setup:api && npm run seed
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && uv sync && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed.run
scripts.seed:reset: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed.run --reset
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
